newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Investors plan first Ukraine investment bank.
newsitem.headline: Investors plan first Ukraine investment bank.

text.p: A group of Ukrainian companies and investors plans this month to ask the central bank to register the country's first specialised investment bank, the project leader said.

"The Pershy Investitsyny Bank (First Investment Bank) will above all be a specialised financial institution to realise government and private investment programmes," Borys Sobolev, nominated as bank president, told Reuters late on Tuesday.

Sobolev said founders include Ukraine's sole aluminium plant OP Mykolayivsky Hlynozemny Zavod, the VAT Poltavsky Hirnycho Zbahachuvalny Zavod ore refinery, the Antonov-Aerotrek airplane manufacturers and finance and investment firms.
Sobolev, a former deputy finance minister, said founders met recently to issue shares in the bank. Plans called for starting capital of five million ecu ($6.25 million) by the end of 1997.
"We've already had talks with some of the world's leading investment banks and we are optimistic that we will be able to strike cooperative agreements with them," he added.
